summary: A row of avatars that overlap, each cut where the one before it lies.

root.note: A row of avatars that does not wrap. It gives its avatars the gap of their crescents; each avatar after the first overlaps the one before by a quarter of its height and is cut by a circle concentric with it.

guidance.text: A div with data-ui="avatar-group", role="group" and an aria-label that says who they are, around avatars, each named as an avatar is.
The avatars are the group's own children, all of one size. The first lies on top and is whole. An avatar wrapped in another element, such as a link, is not stacked.

notYet: A count of the avatars not shown.
Avatars of different sizes in one group.
